```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 06 — Spatial transcriptomics assembly and quality control
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Import four 10x Genomics Visium spatial transcriptomics datasets,
#   construct sample-level Seurat objects, preserve tissue images and spatial
#   coordinates, add consistent sample metadata, merge all slides, join
#   Seurat v5 assay layers, calculate spot-level QC metrics, inspect spatial
#   coverage and sequencing quality, apply validated QC thresholds, generate
#   diagnostic figures and tables, and save the QC-filtered spatial Seurat
#   object for downstream normalization, integration, and clustering.
#
# Input:
#   data/raw/spatial_raw/
#
# Expected slide directories:
#   Naive-A9/
#   Niacin2-B5/
#   Vehicle1-C5/
#   Vehicle2-D5/
#
# Expected count files:
#   Naive-A9/
#     naive_A9_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
#
#   Niacin2-B5/
#     Niacin2_B5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
#
#   Vehicle1-C5/
#     vehicle1_c5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
#
#   Vehicle2-D5/
#     vehicle2_D5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
#
# Primary output object:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/qc/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/qc/
#
# QC thresholds:
#   nFeature_Spatial >= 200
#   percent.mt <= 25
#
# Notes:
#   - Mouse mitochondrial genes are identified using the "^mt-" pattern.
#   - Raw spatial counts are retained for downstream inferCNV and CARD.
#   - No SCTransform, PCA, Harmony, clustering, UMAP, or t-SNE is performed
#     in this module.
#   - Normalization and integration begin in Module 07.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

minimum_features <- 200

maximum_percent_mt <- 25


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_raw_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "spatial_raw"
)

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "qc"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "qc"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  processed_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

qc_filtered_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 06 — Spatial transcriptomics assembly and QC\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:    ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Raw spatial data:   ", spatial_raw_directory, "\n",
  "Processed data:     ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "Results directory: ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Figure directory:  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define spatial sample metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = c(
    "Normal_Tissue",
    "Niacin_Treatment",
    "Vehicle_1",
    "Vehicle_2"
  ),
  condition = c(
    "Normal",
    "Niacin",
    "Vehicle",
    "Vehicle"
  ),
  slide_directory = c(
    "Naive-A9",
    "Niacin2-B5",
    "Vehicle1-C5",
    "Vehicle2-D5"
  ),
  count_file = c(
    "naive_A9_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "Niacin2_B5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "vehicle1_c5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "vehicle2_D5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
  ),
  image_name = c(
    "Naive_A9",
    "Niacin2_B5",
    "Vehicle1_C5",
    "Vehicle2_D5"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat(
  "Spatial samples included:\n"
)

print(
  sample_info
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate raw spatial input directory
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!dir.exists(spatial_raw_directory)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial raw-data directory was not found:\n",
    spatial_raw_directory
  )
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sample_info))) {
  sample_directory <- file.path(
    spatial_raw_directory,
    sample_info$slide_directory[i]
  )

  count_file <- file.path(
    sample_directory,
    sample_info$count_file[i]
  )

  spatial_directory <- file.path(
    sample_directory,
    "spatial"
  )

  if (!dir.exists(sample_directory)) {
    stop(
      "Spatial sample directory was not found:\n",
      sample_directory
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(count_file)) {
    stop(
      "Filtered feature-barcode matrix was not found:\n",
      count_file
    )
  }

  if (!dir.exists(spatial_directory)) {
    stop(
      "10x spatial image/coordinate directory was not found:\n",
      spatial_directory
    )
  }
}

cat(
  "\nAll expected spatial input directories and count files were found.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Function to load one Visium spatial dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

load_spatial_sample <- function(
    sample_name,
    condition,
    slide_directory,
    count_file,
    image_name,
    spatial_raw_directory,
    spatial_assay
) {

  sample_directory <- file.path(
    spatial_raw_directory,
    slide_directory
  )

  cat(
    "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "Loading spatial sample: ", sample_name, "\n",
    "Condition:              ", condition, "\n",
    "Slide directory:        ", slide_directory, "\n",
    "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_object <- Seurat::Load10X_Spatial(
    data.dir = sample_directory,
    filename = count_file,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    slice = image_name,
    filter.matrix = TRUE,
    image.name = "tissue_lowres_image.png"
  )

  if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
    stop(
      "Failed to create Seurat object for sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  spatial_object$sample <- sample_name

  spatial_object$condition <- condition

  spatial_object$slide <- image_name

  cat(
    "Spatial sample loaded successfully:\n",
    "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
    "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
    "  Images:   ",
    paste(
      Seurat::Images(spatial_object),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  return(spatial_object)
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Load all four spatial datasets
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Naive_A9_seurat <- load_spatial_sample(
  sample_name = "Normal_Tissue",
  condition = "Normal",
  slide_directory = "Naive-A9",
  count_file = "naive_A9_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  image_name = "Naive_A9",
  spatial_raw_directory = spatial_raw_directory,
  spatial_assay = spatial_assay
)

Niacin2_B5_seurat <- load_spatial_sample(
  sample_name = "Niacin_Treatment",
  condition = "Niacin",
  slide_directory = "Niacin2-B5",
  count_file = "Niacin2_B5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  image_name = "Niacin2_B5",
  spatial_raw_directory = spatial_raw_directory,
  spatial_assay = spatial_assay
)

Vehicle1_C5_seurat <- load_spatial_sample(
  sample_name = "Vehicle_1",
  condition = "Vehicle",
  slide_directory = "Vehicle1-C5",
  count_file = "vehicle1_c5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  image_name = "Vehicle1_C5",
  spatial_raw_directory = spatial_raw_directory,
  spatial_assay = spatial_assay
)

Vehicle2_D5_seurat <- load_spatial_sample(
  sample_name = "Vehicle_2",
  condition = "Vehicle",
  slide_directory = "Vehicle2-D5",
  count_file = "vehicle2_D5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  image_name = "Vehicle2_D5",
  spatial_raw_directory = spatial_raw_directory,
  spatial_assay = spatial_assay
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Collect and validate individual spatial Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_objects <- list(
  Normal_Tissue = Naive_A9_seurat,
  Niacin_Treatment = Niacin2_B5_seurat,
  Vehicle_1 = Vehicle1_C5_seurat,
  Vehicle_2 = Vehicle2_D5_seurat
)

for (sample_name in names(spatial_objects)) {
  spatial_object <- spatial_objects[[sample_name]]

  if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " is not a valid Seurat object."
    )
  }

  if (!spatial_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {
    stop(
      "Spatial assay was not found in sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (ncol(spatial_object) == 0) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " contains zero spatial spots."
    )
  }

  if (nrow(spatial_object) == 0) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " contains zero features."
    )
  }

  if (length(Seurat::Images(spatial_object)) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No spatial image was retained for sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_object)) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Duplicated spot barcodes detected within sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }
}

cat(
  "\nIndividual spatial object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Create and save individual-object summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

individual_object_summary <- data.frame(
  sample = names(spatial_objects),
  condition = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    function(x) unique(as.character(x$condition))[1],
    character(1)
  ),
  features = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    nrow,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  spots = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    ncol,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  image = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    function(x) paste(Seurat::Images(x), collapse = ";"),
    character(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Individual spatial object summary\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

print(
  individual_object_summary
)

individual_object_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_individual_object_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  individual_object_summary,
  individual_object_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Plot raw tissue sections
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Plotting raw spatial tissue sections\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

normal_tissue_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
  Naive_A9_seurat
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Normal tissue"
  )

niacin_tissue_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
  Niacin2_B5_seurat
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Niacin treatment"
  )

vehicle1_tissue_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
  Vehicle1_C5_seurat
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 1"
  )

vehicle2_tissue_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
  Vehicle2_D5_seurat
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 2"
  )

raw_tissue_plot <- (
  normal_tissue_plot |
  niacin_tissue_plot |
  vehicle1_tissue_plot |
  vehicle2_tissue_plot
)

print(
  raw_tissue_plot
)

raw_tissue_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_raw_tissue_sections.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = raw_tissue_plot_file,
  plot = raw_tissue_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Merge spatial Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Merging spatial Seurat objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_merge <- merge(
  x = Naive_A9_seurat,
  y = list(
    Niacin2_B5_seurat,
    Vehicle1_C5_seurat,
    Vehicle2_D5_seurat
  ),
  add.cell.ids = c(
    "normal",
    "niacin",
    "vehicle1",
    "vehicle2"
  ),
  project = "GBM_spatial"
)

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_merge
) <- spatial_assay

cat(
  "Spatial objects merged successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_merge), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_merge), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(unique(spatial_merge$sample)),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nSpots per sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(spatial_merge$sample)
)

cat(
  "\nImages retained after merge:\n"
)

print(
  Seurat::Images(spatial_merge)
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Validate merged spatial images and sample identities
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_samples <- c(
  "Normal_Tissue",
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(as.character(spatial_merge$sample))
)

if (!identical(
  sort(expected_samples),
  observed_samples
)) {
  stop(
    "Merged object does not contain all expected samples.\n",
    "Observed: ",
    paste(observed_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

expected_images <- c(
  "Naive_A9",
  "Niacin2_B5",
  "Vehicle1_C5",
  "Vehicle2_D5"
)

observed_images <- Seurat::Images(
  spatial_merge
)

missing_images <- setdiff(
  expected_images,
  observed_images
)

if (length(missing_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected spatial images were lost during merging:\n",
    paste(missing_images, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat(
  "Merged sample identities and spatial images validated successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Join Seurat v5 Spatial assay layers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Joining Seurat v5 Spatial assay layers\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

layers_before_joining <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_merge[[spatial_assay]]
)

cat(
  "Spatial assay layers before joining:\n"
)

print(
  layers_before_joining
)

if (length(layers_before_joining) > 1) {
  spatial_merge <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_merge,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}

layers_after_joining <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_merge[[spatial_assay]]
)

cat(
  "\nSpatial assay layers after joining:\n"
)

print(
  layers_after_joining
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Calculate mitochondrial percentage
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Calculating mitochondrial transcript percentage\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_merge[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(
  spatial_merge,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)

mitochondrial_genes <- grep(
  pattern = "^mt-",
  x = rownames(spatial_merge),
  value = TRUE
)

cat(
  "Mitochondrial genes detected: ",
  length(mitochondrial_genes),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (length(mitochondrial_genes) == 0) {
  warning(
    "No mitochondrial genes matched '^mt-'. ",
    "Confirm the mouse gene-symbol naming convention."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nMitochondrial percentage summary:\n"
)

print(
  summary(spatial_merge$percent.mt)
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Validate required QC metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "slide",
  "nCount_Spatial",
  "nFeature_Spatial",
  "percent.mt"
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_merge@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required spatial QC metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_merge)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spatial spot barcodes detected after merging."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Summarize QC before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "QC summary before filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_qc_summary_before <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_spots = dplyr::n(),
    median_counts = median(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_features = median(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_counts = mean(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_features = mean(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_percent_mt = mean(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(
  spatial_qc_summary_before
)

qc_summary_before_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_summary_before_filtering.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  spatial_qc_summary_before,
  qc_summary_before_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Examine candidate QC thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Evaluating candidate spatial QC thresholds\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_qc_thresholds <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_spots = dplyr::n(),
    features_below_200 = sum(
      nFeature_Spatial < 200,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    features_below_300 = sum(
      nFeature_Spatial < 300,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mt_above_10 = sum(
      percent.mt > 10,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mt_above_15 = sum(
      percent.mt > 15,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mt_above_20 = sum(
      percent.mt > 20,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mt_above_25 = sum(
      percent.mt > 25,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(
  spatial_qc_thresholds
)

qc_threshold_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_threshold_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  spatial_qc_thresholds,
  qc_threshold_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Calculate candidate threshold percentages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_qc_threshold_percentages <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_spots = dplyr::n(),
    percent_below_200_features =
      mean(nFeature_Spatial < 200, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percent_below_300_features =
      mean(nFeature_Spatial < 300, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_10 =
      mean(percent.mt > 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_15 =
      mean(percent.mt > 15, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_20 =
      mean(percent.mt > 20, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    percent_mt_above_25 =
      mean(percent.mt > 25, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\nCandidate QC threshold percentages:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_qc_threshold_percentages
)

qc_threshold_percentage_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_threshold_percentages.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  spatial_qc_threshold_percentages,
  qc_threshold_percentage_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Generate QC violin plots before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Generating QC violin plots\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

qc_violin_plot <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_Spatial",
    "nCount_Spatial",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1
)

print(
  qc_violin_plot
)

qc_violin_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_QC_violin_plots_before_filtering.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = qc_violin_file,
  plot = qc_violin_plot,
  width = 15,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Generate spatial sequencing-depth QC plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Plotting spatial sequencing depth\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

normal_count_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nCount_Spatial",
  images = "Naive_A9"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Normal tissue"
  )

niacin_count_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nCount_Spatial",
  images = "Niacin2_B5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Niacin treatment"
  )

vehicle1_count_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nCount_Spatial",
  images = "Vehicle1_C5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 1"
  )

vehicle2_count_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nCount_Spatial",
  images = "Vehicle2_D5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 2"
  )

spatial_count_plot <- (
  normal_count_plot |
  niacin_count_plot |
  vehicle1_count_plot |
  vehicle2_count_plot
)

print(
  spatial_count_plot
)

spatial_count_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_nCount_QC.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = spatial_count_plot_file,
  plot = spatial_count_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Generate spatial feature-count QC plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Plotting spatial detected-feature counts\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

normal_feature_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nFeature_Spatial",
  images = "Naive_A9"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Normal tissue"
  )

niacin_feature_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nFeature_Spatial",
  images = "Niacin2_B5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Niacin treatment"
  )

vehicle1_feature_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nFeature_Spatial",
  images = "Vehicle1_C5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 1"
  )

vehicle2_feature_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "nFeature_Spatial",
  images = "Vehicle2_D5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 2"
  )

spatial_feature_plot <- (
  normal_feature_plot |
  niacin_feature_plot |
  vehicle1_feature_plot |
  vehicle2_feature_plot
)

print(
  spatial_feature_plot
)

spatial_feature_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_nFeature_QC.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = spatial_feature_plot_file,
  plot = spatial_feature_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Generate spatial mitochondrial QC plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Plotting spatial mitochondrial percentage\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

normal_mt_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "percent.mt",
  images = "Naive_A9"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Normal tissue"
  )

niacin_mt_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "percent.mt",
  images = "Niacin2_B5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Niacin treatment"
  )

vehicle1_mt_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "percent.mt",
  images = "Vehicle1_C5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 1"
  )

vehicle2_mt_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = "percent.mt",
  images = "Vehicle2_D5"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Vehicle 2"
  )

spatial_mt_plot <- (
  normal_mt_plot |
  niacin_mt_plot |
  vehicle1_mt_plot |
  vehicle2_mt_plot
)

print(
  spatial_mt_plot
)

spatial_mt_plot_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_percent_mt_QC.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = spatial_mt_plot_file,
  plot = spatial_mt_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Define selected QC thresholds
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Selected spatial QC thresholds\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Minimum detected features:  ", minimum_features, "\n",
  "Maximum mitochondrial RNA: ", maximum_percent_mt, "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Estimate spot retention before filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_retention_expected <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    spots_before = dplyr::n(),
    spots_retained = sum(
      nFeature_Spatial >= minimum_features &
      percent.mt <= maximum_percent_mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    spots_removed =
      spots_before -
      spots_retained,
    percent_retained =
      100 *
      spots_retained /
      spots_before,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\nExpected spot retention using selected thresholds:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_retention_expected
)

retention_expected_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_expected_retention.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  spatial_retention_expected,
  retention_expected_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Apply spatial QC filters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Applying spatial QC filters\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spots_before_filtering <- ncol(
  spatial_merge
)

spatial_qc <- subset(
  spatial_merge,
  subset =
    nFeature_Spatial >= minimum_features &
    percent.mt <= maximum_percent_mt
)

spots_after_filtering <- ncol(
  spatial_qc
)

spots_removed <- spots_before_filtering -
  spots_after_filtering

if (spots_after_filtering == 0) {
  stop(
    "Spatial QC filtering removed all spots."
  )
}

cat(
  "Spots before filtering: ",
  spots_before_filtering,
  "\n",
  "Spots after filtering:  ",
  spots_after_filtering,
  "\n",
  "Spots removed:          ",
  spots_removed,
  "\n",
  "Overall retention:      ",
  round(
    100 *
    spots_after_filtering /
    spots_before_filtering,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Summarize QC after filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_qc_summary_after <- spatial_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_spots = dplyr::n(),
    median_counts = median(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_features = median(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_counts = mean(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_features = mean(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_percent_mt = mean(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "QC summary after filtering\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

print(
  spatial_qc_summary_after
)

qc_summary_after_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_summary_after_filtering.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  spatial_qc_summary_after,
  qc_summary_after_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Create final filtering summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spots_before_by_sample <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots_before"
  )

spots_after_by_sample <- spatial_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots_after"
  )

filtering_summary <- spots_before_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    spots_after_by_sample,
    by = c(
      "sample",
      "condition"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    spots_after = ifelse(
      is.na(spots_after),
      0,
      spots_after
    ),
    spots_removed =
      spots_before -
      spots_after,
    percent_retained =
      100 *
      spots_after /
      spots_before
  )

cat(
  "\nFinal spot filtering summary:\n"
)

print(
  filtering_summary
)

filtering_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_QC_filtering_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  filtering_summary,
  filtering_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Generate QC violin plots after filtering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qc_violin_after_plot <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  spatial_qc,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_Spatial",
    "nCount_Spatial",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1
)

print(
  qc_violin_after_plot
)

qc_violin_after_file <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "spatial_QC_violin_plots_after_filtering.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = qc_violin_after_file,
  plot = qc_violin_after_plot,
  width = 15,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Validate QC-filtered spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating QC-filtered spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (!inherits(spatial_qc, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered spatial object is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

if (!spatial_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_qc)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial assay was not retained after QC filtering."
  )
}

if (any(
  spatial_qc$nFeature_Spatial <
  minimum_features
)) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered object contains spots below the feature threshold."
  )
}

if (any(
  spatial_qc$percent.mt >
  maximum_percent_mt
)) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered object contains spots above the mitochondrial threshold."
  )
}

observed_samples_after_qc <- sort(
  unique(as.character(spatial_qc$sample))
)

if (!identical(
  sort(expected_samples),
  observed_samples_after_qc
)) {
  stop(
    "One or more samples were lost during spatial QC filtering.\n",
    "Observed samples: ",
    paste(
      observed_samples_after_qc,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

images_after_qc <- Seurat::Images(
  spatial_qc
)

missing_images_after_qc <- setdiff(
  expected_images,
  images_after_qc
)

if (length(missing_images_after_qc) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more spatial images were lost after QC filtering:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images_after_qc,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_qc)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spatial spot barcodes detected after QC filtering."
  )
}

cat(
  "QC-filtered spatial object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Save QC-filtered spatial Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving QC-filtered spatial Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

saveRDS(
  object = spatial_qc,
  file = qc_filtered_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(qc_filtered_file)) {
  stop(
    "QC-filtered spatial Seurat object was not saved successfully:\n",
    qc_filtered_file
  )
}

cat(
  "QC-filtered spatial object saved successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Validate expected Module 06 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_result_files <- c(
  individual_object_summary_file,
  qc_summary_before_file,
  qc_threshold_file,
  qc_threshold_percentage_file,
  retention_expected_file,
  qc_summary_after_file,
  filtering_summary_file
)

expected_figure_files <- c(
  raw_tissue_plot_file,
  qc_violin_file,
  spatial_count_plot_file,
  spatial_feature_plot_file,
  spatial_mt_plot_file,
  qc_violin_after_file
)

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 06 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 06 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 06 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 06 COMPLETE — Spatial transcriptomics assembly and QC\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Input slides:              ", length(spatial_objects), "\n",
  "Features:                  ", nrow(spatial_qc), "\n",
  "Spots before QC:           ", spots_before_filtering, "\n",
  "Spots after QC:            ", spots_after_filtering, "\n",
  "Spots removed:             ", spots_removed, "\n",
  "Samples retained:          ",
  length(unique(spatial_qc$sample)),
  "\n",
  "Spatial images retained:   ",
  length(Seurat::Images(spatial_qc)),
  "\n",
  "Minimum features:          ", minimum_features, "\n",
  "Maximum mitochondrial RNA: ", maximum_percent_mt, "%\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", qc_filtered_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "QC result tables:\n",
  "  ", results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "QC figures:\n",
  "  ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  07_spatial_normalization_clustering.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
